sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-165.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 165 was established by Ordinance No. 18046, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 16, 1983. Ordinance No. 18046 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Subsequently, Ordinance No. 18046 was amended by Ordinance Nos. 20184 and 20186, passed by the Dallas City Council on January 25, 1989; Ordinance No. 20919, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 10, 1991; and Ordinance No. 22546, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 13, 1995. Ordinance No. 20184 changed the zoning of a 7.589-acre portion of the Property from PD 165 to a CR-D Community Retail-Dry District. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18046; 20184; 20186; 20919; 22546; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-165.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 165 is established on property generally located at the northeast corner of Rosemeade Parkway and Midway Road. The size of PD 165 is approximately 167.30 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20184; 20186; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-165.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-165.104.CONCEPTUAL PLAN. A conceptual plan, as approved by the city plan commission, is labelled Exhibit 165A. (Ord. Nos. 18046; 22546; 25508)

sections.title: Detailed Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-165.105.DETAILED DEVELOPMENT PLAN. Within six months of the date of passage of Ordinance No. 18046, a detailed development plan for either the entire PD or a designated first phase of development must be submitted to the city plan commission for approval prior to the issuance of a building permit for the Property. The detailed development plan must comply with the approved conceptual plan and this article. If a development plan is submitted for a designated first phase of development only, a subsequent development plan is required for each subsequent phase of development. Each such subsequent development plan must be approved by the commission prior to the issuance of a building permit for that phase of development. (Ord. Nos. 18046; 25508)

sections.title: Permitted Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-165.106.PERMITTED USES. The only permitted uses for all tracts on the Property are as follows:
(1)Tracts 1A, 1B, 1C, and 1D. All uses permitted in an Office-2 District including “Limited Uses,” plus the following: warehouse; design or decorative center; trade center; safe deposit boxes; game court center; inside commercial amusement; all motor vehicle related uses; helistop; and all medical uses. In addition to the above, the restaurant with alcoholic beverages and/or entertainment use is permitted in Tract 1B only.
(2)Tracts 2A and 2B. All uses permitted in a shopping center district. In addition to those uses permitted in the shopping center district, the mini-warehouse use is permitted on Tract 2B by specific use permit only.
(3)Tract 3A.All uses permitted in an MF-1 Multiple-Family District, with a maximum of 828 dwelling units permitted, plus the private recreation club or area use.
(4)Tract 3B. A maximum of 110 single-family dwelling units, attached or detached.
(5)Tract 3C.A maximum of eight single-family dwelling units, attached or detached. (Ord. Nos. 22546; 25508)

sections.title: Maximum Permitted Heights
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-165.107.MAXIMUM PERMITTED HEIGHTS. Maximum permitted heights for all buildings and structures on the Property are as follows:
(1)Tract 1A. One hundred and fifty feet.
(2)Tract 1B. One hundred and twenty feet.
(3)Tract 1C. Ninety-six feet.
(4)Tract 1D. One hundred and twenty feet.
(5)Tract 2. Thirty-six feet.
(6)Tract 3A. Thirty-six feet.
(7)Tract 3B. Twenty-four feet.
(8)Tract 3C. Twenty-four feet. (Ord. Nos. 20919; 25508)

sections.title: Maximum Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-165.108.MAXIMUM FLOOR AREA. Maximum permitted floor areas for all buildings on Tracts 1A, 1B, 1C, 1D, 2A, and 2B are as follows:
(1)Tracts 1A, 1B, 1C, and 1D combined. 2,000,000 square feet.
(2)Tracts 2A and 2B combined. 475,000 square feet.
(3)Tract 2B. 125,000 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 22546; 25508)

sections.title: Maximum Lot Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-165.109.MAXIMUM LOT COVERAGE. Maximum lot coverage requirements for the Property are as follows:
(1)Tracts 1A, 1B, 1C, and 1D. Thirty-five percent.
(2)Tract 2. Forty percent, excluding and parking structures.
(3)Tract 2B. Fifty percent, excluding parking structures.
(4)Tract 3A. Fifty percent.
(5)Tracts 3B and 3C. In these tracts, 80 percent of an individual lot may be covered by structures, if the coverage in the entire tract does not exceed 60 percent. (Ord. Nos. 22546; 25508)

sections.title: Minimum Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-165.110.MINIMUM SETBACKS. The minimum setbacks for all buildings and structures on the Property are as follows:
(1)Tracts 1A, 1B, 1C, and 1D.
(A)Front yard. Fifty feet.
(B)Rear yard. Ten feet.
(C)Side yard.One foot for each two feet of height, with a 50 foot maximum.
(2)Tract 2A.
(A)Front yard. Twenty-five feet.
(B)Rear yard. Ten feet.
(C)Side yard. Ten feet.
(3)Tract 2B.
(A)For uses permitted in the Shopping Center District:
(i)Front yard. Twenty-five feet.
(ii)Rear yard. Ten feet.
(iii)Side yard. Ten feet.
(B)For a mini-warehouse use:
(i)Front yard (adjacent to Rosemeade Parkway). Twenty-five feet.
(ii)Front yard (adjacent to State Highway 190). Five feet.
(iii)Side yard (eastern boundary of Tract 2B). Five feet.
(iv)Side yard (western boundary of Tract 2B). Three feet.
(v)Rear yard. Five feet.
(4)Tract 3A.
(A)Front yard. Fifteen feet.
(B)Rear yard. Fifteen feet.
(C)Side yard. Ten feet.
(5)Tracts 3B and 3C. All setbacks in these tracts must comply with Townhouse-2 District standards. (Ord. Nos. 22546; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-165.111.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. Development of the Property must comply with the requirements of all ordinances and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18046; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-165.112.PAVING. All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 18046; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-165.113.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article and with the construction codes and all other applicable ordinances of the Dallas City Code. (Ord. Nos. 18046; 25508)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-165.114.ZONING MAP. PD 165 is located on Zoning Map No. AA-6. (Ord. Nos. 18046; 25508)
